subject: biology
title: Two Sides of the Same Coin
welcome_lead: Compare photosynthesis and respiration and see how they balance life on Earth.
meta_desc: KS3 Biology adventure comparing photosynthesis and respiration.
final_note: You can now compare the two reactions and explain their roles together.

concepts.def: Site of respiration in all cells.
Plant that makes food by photosynthesis.

walkthroughs.body_html: Photosynthesis uses CO₂ + water, makes glucose + oxygen, needs light, happens in chloroplasts. Respiration uses glucose + oxygen, makes CO₂ + water, releases energy, happens in mitochondria.
Yes! Plants photosynthesise in light and respire all the time. Animals only respire, so they depend on plants for food and oxygen.
Photosynthesis takes in CO₂ and releases O₂. Respiration does the opposite. Together they keep atmospheric gases in balance.

numericals.q: If photosynthesis makes 8 g of O₂ and respiration uses 3 g, net O₂ left?
